author: reek
body: Converts PCB board data into 3D mesh geometry for rendering. Each copper layer is extruded into a thin slab, vias become cylinders, the board substrate is a thick slab between copper layers. Component 3D models are placed at their footprint coordinates.

author: reek
body: Each copper layer is at a specific Z height determined by the stack-up. The substrate fills the gap between copper layers.
